answer: Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 151 aliases, and each one needs its own funded orchard account. Deposits are visible in oasis, and falcon reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 32% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 2 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
